turns.content: Can you explain how to feed a sourdough starter at 100% hydration?
Combine equal parts by weight of flour and water.
What are good companion plants for tomatoes?
Basil, marigolds, and carrots make excellent companion plants.
What water temperature is ideal for pour-over coffee?
The recommended temperature is between 90C and 96C.
How often should I replace marathon training shoes?
Typically every 300 to 500 miles depending on running surface.
Can you suggest classic science fiction novels?
Dune by Frank Herbert, Foundation by Isaac Asimov, and Neuromancer.
Why is my sourdough loaf coming out dense?
Dense loaves often result from under-fermentation or weak gluten development.
What essentials should I pack for a day hike?
Navigation, hydration, trail snacks, first aid kit, and weather layers.
How do I care for a Monstera Deliciosa?
Provide bright indirect light and water when top soil feels dry.
What is the ratio of flour to eggs for fresh pasta?
The traditional ratio is 100 grams of flour per whole egg.

The Perseids peak annually between August 11th and August 13th.
